author: A Google user
review_text: What is the use of this app if you have to open a web browser every time to use esewa even if internet access is readily available? Why does a customer pay more using SMS if he can use internet? Almost everyone have internet access, so this app has a rare/emergency use only where no internet is available. The time for opening a web browser and then opening esewa web page can be saved for customers if the Developers can add logging in feature in the app just as u guys have made in the Global Smart app.
